description: Defines the SearchParams struct and related functions for handling search query parameters, including parsing search strings into structured parameters and validating parameter lists.

classes.name: SearchParams
classes.description: Struct representing search query parameters, including terms, filters, date ranges, and flags.

methods.name: GetAfterDateMillis
methods.description: Calculates epoch milliseconds for the start of the day after the specified AfterDate.

methods.name: GetExcludedAfterDateMillis
methods.description: Calculates epoch milliseconds for the start of the day after the specified ExcludedAfterDate.

methods.name: GetBeforeDateMillis
methods.description: Calculates epoch milliseconds for the end of the day before the specified BeforeDate.

methods.name: GetExcludedBeforeDateMillis
methods.description: Calculates epoch milliseconds for the end of the day before the specified ExcludedBeforeDate.

methods.name: GetOnDateMillis
methods.description: Returns epoch milliseconds for the start and end of the specified OnDate.

methods.name: GetExcludedDateMillis
methods.description: Returns epoch milliseconds for the start and end of the specified ExcludedDate.
